author_confirmation.artifact:
The author has now confirmed the previously unresolved source conventions and
parameter interpretation. Therefore, the 28 items previously classified as
`requires_author_confirmation` must no longer block the PCFF-PDMS workflow.

Update their status to:

    author_confirmed

The remaining 19 items genuinely require QM fitting because their numerical
values are not supplied by the author and cannot be derived from existing
source rows.
author_confirmation.limitation: The reported confirmation changes planning status. Exact confirmed equations, applicability, values and author date require the primary artifact; none is inferred from family or backend defaults.
author_confirmation.scope: 28 previously author-confirmation-classified directed FRC queries only
